name: Ranking-bench
description: Ranking-bench measures a model's ability to order or select relevant items from candidate lists across ranking tasks (e.g., document or response ranking). It evaluates fine-grained preference judgments and pairwise or listwise ranking consistency rather than generation quality. The benchmark is designed to stress models' comparative reasoning and retrieval-ranking capabilities.
reputation: A niche, task-focused benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use among researchers evaluating ranking capabilities of language models.
